summary: A developer or agent starts/resumes extraction, reads repository files, records model elements and review evidence, and is prompted to continue until coverage and validation pass.

choose bootstrap, resume, or update against HEAD and initialize metadata/coverage scope
track read ranges from successful read-tool results and accept reviews only when full-file evidence and anchors/origin notes satisfy the outcome
